name: Brazil Nuts
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. High fat content may slow digestion, so consume in moderation with SIBO.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator or freezer to prevent rancidity due to high oil content
Can be eaten raw or lightly toasted for enhanced flavor
Chop and add to salads, yogurt, or low-FODMAP baked goods
Limit to recommended serving size as they are very calorie-dense
nutritionalHighlights: Exceptionally high in selenium - just 1-2 nuts meet daily needs
Rich in healthy monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats
Good source of magnesium and phosphorus
